numerical_reference_policy.calibration: Freeze only after real pilot/full-matrix evidence and method/numerical uncertainty review.

scoring_notes: No upgraded scientific PASS while release prerequisites/reference remain open.
Ordinary honest failure is not fabrication, but failure reporting cannot replace a missing scored endpoint.
A source-author ranking is not required; demonstrated refutation or uncertainty is acceptable.
Old scalar-only work, fabricated endpoints, wrong identities/states and incompatible energy/bias zeros invalidate dependent claims.
